(()=>{if(JSON.stringify(savedVectors)===JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('.arch-paper [data-viewport]')].map(e=>e.innerHTML)))throw Error('Fixture did not change geometry');const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.arch-issue-history-card')];if(!cards[0].textContent.includes('PARTIALLY SUPERSEDED'))throw Error('Missing partial label');[...cards[0].querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Inspect layout').click();})()

(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.arch-paper');if(!s||s.textContent.includes('LIVE')||!s.textContent.includes('Original issued address'))throw Error('Live metadata leaked into history');if(JSON.stringify(savedVectors)!==JSON.stringify([...s.querySelectorAll('[data-viewport]')].map(e=>e.innerHTML)))throw Error('History geometry differs from issued geometry');s.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return {title:s.textContent,geometryMatches:true};})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.arch-paper'))throw Error('Incomplete history rendered live geometry');const e=document.querySelector('.arch-history-unavailable');e.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});if(historyErrors.length)throw Error(historyErrors.join(';'));return {message:e.textContent,errors:historyErrors};})()
